violation_type.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED- Supervised By Qualified Caregiver (26 TAC §746.1109(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption with HS Diploma/GED- Supervised By Qualified Caregiver
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation allowed a 17-year old caregiver to supervise children in care at the operation without another fully qualified caregiver present at all times.

finding_variants.text: The operation allowed a 17-year old caregiver to supervise children in care at the operation without another fully qualified caregiver present at all times.
Based on the information gathered another caregiver that was not qualified was left alone more than occasion with a group of children.
Proof of education needed for three caregivers..
